'''Hanadak repellent''' was a [[Magic/Legends|magical]] device concocted by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. When Teebo, [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] went to look for their friend [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who had gone to find the [[hanadak]], Teebo brought the repellent with him for safety.
